entries.text: Programming fundamentals: variables store values; conditions select paths; loops repeat work; functions package reusable behavior.
Data structures: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, trees and graphs.
Algorithms: linear search, binary search, sorting, recursion, traversal, greedy methods and dynamic programming.
Complexity: Big O describes growth of time or memory as input size increases.
Debugging: reproduce the bug, read the error, isolate the smallest failing case, inspect values, test the fix and prevent regression.
Software design: separation of concerns, modularity, meaningful names, small functions, validation and tests.
Python topics: list, tuple, dict, set, comprehension, exception handling, virtual environments, pip and modules.
C++ topics: variables, references, pointers, classes, templates, STL containers and memory management.
Java topics: classes, interfaces, collections, exceptions, generics and JVM.
C# topics: classes, interfaces, LINQ, async/await and .NET.
JavaScript async programming: Promise, async/await, try/catch, Promise.all and cancellation patterns.
